incidents.title: Disk saturation on compute nodes
incidents.symptoms: Pods of the data namespace go Evicted in waves.
incidents.root_cause: Application logs were not rotated on the batch node group nodes.
incidents.fix: Rotation enabled and disk alert threshold lowered to 80 %.

incidents.title: Expired certificate on the ingress gateway
incidents.symptoms: All HTTPS requests fail with a verification error.
incidents.root_cause: Automatic renewal had silently failed three weeks earlier.
incidents.fix: Alert on certificate expiry at 21 days.

incidents.title: Restart loop after a version upgrade
incidents.symptoms: The container restarts in a loop right after the deployment.
incidents.root_cause: A mandatory environment variable had been renamed without updating the chart.
incidents.fix: Schema validation of the Helm values in continuous integration.

incidents.title: Lost messages on the notifications queue
incidents.symptoms: Some notifications are never delivered, with no error on the producer side.
incidents.root_cause: The queue retention was shorter than the consumer recovery delay.
incidents.fix: Retention raised to 7 days and alert on the oldest message age.

incidents.title: Subnet IP address exhaustion
incidents.root_cause: The subnet CIDR range no longer fitted the pod count after scaling up.

incidents.title: Slow queries after a cache purge
incidents.symptoms: P95 doubles for about ten minutes after each redeployment.
incidents.root_cause: The cache was emptied at startup without warm-up.

incidents.title: Double billing on replayed orders
incidents.symptoms: Some customers are charged twice for the same order.
incidents.root_cause: The automatic replay did not check the idempotency key.
incidents.fix: Idempotency key made mandatory in the API.

incidents.title: Identity provider outage
incidents.symptoms: No login possible, service accounts included.
incidents.root_cause: Outage of the external identity provider, no fallback configured.

incidents.title: Clock drift on a node
incidents.symptoms: Request signatures rejected by a partner.
incidents.root_cause: The time synchronisation service was stopped on one node.

incidents.title: Blocked on a schema migration
incidents.symptoms: The deployment stays blocked, the database rejects writes.
incidents.root_cause: A migration took an exclusive lock on a large table.

incidents.title: File descriptor leak
incidents.symptoms: The service stops accepting connections after several hours.
incidents.root_cause: Temporary files were not closed on exceptions.
incidents.fix: Systematic close and alert on descriptor count.

incidents.title: Cascading rejections behind rate limiting
incidents.symptoms: A legitimate traffic peak triggers mass rejections.
incidents.root_cause: The limit was computed per pod, not globally.
incidents.fix: Rate limiting moved to the gateway.

incidents.title: Unreadable backup at restore time
incidents.symptoms: The test restore fails on a corrupted archive.
incidents.root_cause: The backup was taken during a write, without quiescing.
incidents.fix: Consistent snapshot and monthly restore test.

incidents.title: CPU contention after adding a sidecar
incidents.symptoms: P99 rises by 40 % without application change.
incidents.root_cause: The sidecar had no CPU limit and starved the main container.

runbooks.title: Node in NotReady
runbooks.symptoms: A node turns NotReady and its pods are evicted.
runbooks.procedure:
1. Check the node disk and memory pressure.
2. Check the kubelet and the container runtime.
3. Cordon then drain before any intervention.

runbooks.title: TLS certificate close to expiry
runbooks.symptoms: A certificate expiry is reported within 21 days.
runbooks.procedure:
1. Identify the issuer and the renewal mode.
2. Trigger the renewal.
3. Check the chain presented by the gateway.

runbooks.title: Message queue lagging
runbooks.symptoms: The age of the oldest message exceeds the threshold.
runbooks.procedure:
1. Compare production and consumption rates.
2. Check consumer errors.
3. Increase parallelism if processing is the bottleneck.

runbooks.title: Critical disk space on a node
runbooks.procedure:
1. Identify the largest consumers.
2. Purge unused images.
3. Check log rotation.

runbooks.title: Database restore
runbooks.procedure:
1. Freeze writes.
2. Identify the last valid restore point.
3. Restore to a control instance before switching.

runbooks.title: Manual failover of a replicated database
runbooks.procedure:
1. Confirm the primary is really down.
2. Check the replication lag.
3. Promote the replica and repoint the services.

runbooks.title: Abnormal traffic from an address range
runbooks.symptoms: Request peak concentrated on few addresses.
runbooks.procedure:
1. Characterise the pattern.
2. Apply a targeted limit.
3. Escalate if the pattern persists.

runbooks.title: Rollout blocked mid-way
runbooks.procedure:
1. Read the ReplicaSet state and the events.
2. Check available resources.
3. Roll back to the previous revision if the service is degraded.

runbooks.title: Sustained CPU saturation alert
runbooks.symptoms: CPU usage stays at the ceiling for more than 15 minutes.
runbooks.procedure:
1. Tell a legitimate load from a loop.
2. Check the container limits.
3. Adjust replicas before limits.

runbooks.title: Lost application logs
runbooks.symptoms: A service's logs no longer reach the collector.
runbooks.procedure:
1. Check the collection agent on the node.
2. Check the application output format.
3. Check the collector quotas.

runbooks.title: Missing metrics for a service
runbooks.symptoms: A service's series disappear from the dashboards.
runbooks.procedure:
1. Check the scrape annotations on the pods.
2. Check that /metrics is reachable.
3. Check the relabel rules.

runbooks.title: Service credential rotation
runbooks.procedure:
1. Generate the new credential.
2. Deploy with double validity.
3. Revoke the old one after verification.

runbooks.title: Scaling up before a sales event
runbooks.procedure:
1. Read the load of the previous equivalent peak.
2. Pre-size the replicas.
3. Check the vendor quotas.

runbooks.title: 502 errors behind the gateway
runbooks.procedure:
1. Check the Service endpoints.
2. Compare gateway and application timeouts.
3. Check recent restarts.

runbooks.title: Drift between declared and actual state
runbooks.symptoms: A gap persists between the repository and the cluster.
runbooks.procedure:
1. Read the drift report.
2. Identify a possible manual change.
3. Resync after validation.

runbooks.title: Namespace stuck in Terminating
runbooks.procedure:
1. List the remaining resources.
2. Identify the blocking finalizers.
3. Remove the finalizer after verification.

runbooks.title: Startup probe too short
runbooks.symptoms: The pod is killed before it finishes starting.
runbooks.procedure:
1. Measure the real startup time.
2. Use a startupProbe rather than lengthening liveness.
3. Validate again after deployment.

runbooks.title: Namespace quota reached
runbooks.procedure:
1. Compare the summed requests with the quota.
2. Identify oversized workloads.
3. Adjust requests before the quota.

runbooks.title: Clock out of sync on a node
runbooks.procedure:
1. Check the synchronisation service.
2. Measure the drift.
3. Restart the service and watch.

runbooks.title: Container image not found
runbooks.procedure:
1. Check the image name and tag.
2. Check the registry credentials.
3. Check the pull quotas.

runbooks.title: Persistent volume not attached
runbooks.symptoms: The pod waits for its volume.
runbooks.procedure:
1. Check the availability zone of the volume and of the node.
2. Check the claim state.
3. Check the storage controller.

runbooks.title: Replication lagging
runbooks.procedure:
1. Measure the lag and its trend.
2. Identify a long transaction on the primary.
3. Avoid any failover while the lag grows.

runbooks.title: Connection leak towards a third-party service
runbooks.symptoms: The number of established connections grows and never goes down.
runbooks.procedure:
1. Count connections by state.
2. Check HTTP client reuse.
3. Set a cap and an idle timeout.
